name: VibeStack Stock Alert
author: stefanvibestackapp

sections.description:
VibeStack Stock Alert sends you an instant email the moment any product hits zero inventory. No dashboards to check. No manual monitoring. Just the right information at the right time.

Features:

  • Instant email alerts when any product hits zero stock
  • Variant-level alerts — works for sizes, colors, and all product variations
  • Automatic detection, no setup required
  • Works silently in the background, always on
  • Free forever

Built by VibeStack — back-office software for independent merchants.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. That’s it — alerts are active immediately, no configuration needed
sections.faq:
Which email address receives the alerts?

Alerts are sent to the admin email address configured in your WordPress settings under Settings → General.

Does this work with product variations?

Yes. If a specific variant (size, color, etc.) goes out of stock, you’ll get an alert for that specific variant.

Is there any setup required?

No. Activate the plugin and it starts working immediately.

short_description: Instant email alerts when your WooCommerce products go out of stock. Free forever.
